title: onSuccessDestroyEmail not implemented in EmailSubmission/set
description: RFC 8621 §7.5 defines onSuccessDestroyEmail: Id[]|null alongside onSuccessUpdateEmail. The submission handler (submission.rs) reads and processes onSuccessUpdateEmail but entirely ignores onSuccessDestroyEmail. A client sending onSuccessDestroyEmail gets no error and no destroy happens — silent spec non-compliance.
